t00.speaker: neha
t00.text: Kairos is a decision engine for collections. Every day, for every borrower, it decides whether to make contact, on which channel, and when. Here is how each part works.
t00.tts: Kairos is a decision engine for collections. Every day, for every borrower, it decides whether to make contact, on which channel, and when. Here is how each part works.

t01.speaker: neha
t01.text: Everything starts from one record per borrower: loans, EMIs, payments, consent for each channel, and every event. Money is kept in paise, so totals never drift.
t01.tts: Everything starts from one record per borrower: loans, EMIs, payments, consent for each channel, and every event. Money is kept in paise, so totals never drift.

t02.speaker: neha
t02.text: Each morning, the churn engine sorts every borrower again, by cohort, risk, contact layer and status. Every move records the rule that fired and the inputs it read.
t02.tts: Each morning, the churn engine sorts every borrower again, by cohort, risk, contact layer and status. Every move records the rule that fired and the inputs it read.

t03a.speaker: neha
t03a.text: The learner is a Bayesian model. Every channel and hour keeps a reply-chance estimate for each group of borrowers, and each touch earns exactly one reward when its 24-hour reply window closes.
t03a.tts: The learner is a Bayesian model. Every channel and hour keeps a reply chance estimate for each group of borrowers, and each touch earns exactly one reward when its 24 hour reply window closes.

t03b.speaker: neha
t03b.text: On day 7 we cut WhatsApp replies to a third and told it nothing. By the end of day 14, that segment had moved to SMS.

t04.speaker: neha
t04.text: Models only suggest. Aladdin decides what may happen. When a message is planned, it reserves budget and contact limits in one atomic step. At send time, it checks every rule again. If anything has changed, nothing is sent.
t04.tts: Models only suggest. Alaadin decides what may happen. When a message is planned, it reserves budget and contact limits in one atomic step. At send time, it checks every rule again. If anything has changed, nothing is sent.

t05.speaker: neha
t05.text: Adapters send through each channel. Receipts and replies come back as webhooks. Duplicates are ignored, and a delivery is never counted as a reply.

t06.speaker: neha
t06.text: Inbound chats run a small state machine. Nothing about the account is shared until a one-time code is verified. Payment proof is checked for edits, hidden instructions and reused references, and a fake never marks anything paid.
